description: Environment setup and baseline: install dependencies with npm ci and confirm lint and build pass on the unmodified code before any edits.
steps: From the repo root (quote the path, it contains spaces) run: npm ci
Run: npm run lint and record the result
Run: npm run build and record the result (output goes to out/)
Record in findings whether out\winutil.ps1 exists after the baseline build (expected: it does not, because public/winutil.ps1 does not exist). Do not open, read, move or copy any winutil.ps1 file.
If npm ci fails due to network or sandbox restrictions, record the exact error in findings and mark blocked with retryable true
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint exits 0 on the baseline
npm run build exits 0 on the baseline

blocked_reason.detail: npm ci failed with network error: 'npm error code ENOTFOUND / syscall getaddrinfo / network request to https://registry.npmjs.org/zod-validation-error/-/zod-validation-error-4.0.2.tgz failed, reason: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND registry.npmjs.org'. The sandbox has no DNS/network access to the npm registry. node_modules does not exist, so npm run lint and npm run build cannot run.

findings: Environment: Node v24.22.0, npm 11.19.1. npm ci exit 1 (ENOTFOUND registry.npmjs.org, sandbox network restriction). node_modules absent before and after (Test-Path node_modules = False). Lint and build NOT run (no dependencies installed). Test-Path out\winutil.ps1 = False (no out/ dir; no build ran). Test-Path public\winutil.ps1 = False, confirming public/winutil.ps1 does not exist; the user's winutil.ps1 is untracked at repo root and was not touched. git status clean except untracked .agents/ and winutil.ps1; git works only with $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='NUL' (warning about .kiro/settings permission denied is harmless). No source changes made, no commits. RETRY (npm ci --offline): exit 1, 'npm error code ENOTCACHED: request to https://registry.npmjs.org/zod-validation-error/-/zod-validation-error-4.0.2.tgz failed: cache mode is only-if-cached but no cached response is available'. Local npm cache (sandbox npm-cache under AppData\Local\Packages\kiro-sandbox-pool-2) does not contain the lockfile packages. npm cleanup also warned EPERM rmdir node_modules\@eslint-community; the leftover node_modules dir was empty (0 files) and was removed with a non-recursive Remove-Item. Baseline lint/build still NOT run. Needs a machine with registry access.
